effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDS from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
Mints vault shares (skyMoneyUsdsRiskCapital) to `onBehalf`. The share count comes from previewDeposit after accrueInterest, using the stored exchange rate net of fees.
Uses the signer's existing USDS allowance to the vault.
Accrues management and performance fees as new shares to the fee recipients before pricing the deposit, which lowers the shares minted.
formats.shown: Deposit <assets> USDS for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker and the share recipient as fields.

findings.title: deposit: number of vault shares minted to onBehalf is not shown, since it comes from the stored exchange rate
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. previewDeposit uses _totalAssets, totalSupply and fee shares from storage. The descriptor shows only the ticker constant 'Share ticker' = skyMoneyUsdsRiskCapital. Case 0 minted 1e18 shares to 0xdEaD (signer null).
findings.fix: None possible in calldata. Optionally rename 'Share ticker' to 'You receive shares of' to make the field's meaning clearer.

findings.title: deposit: interpolated intent does not name the vault or say that shares are received
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Deposit {#.assets} for {#.onBehalf}'. In case 0 the screen reads 'Deposit 1 USDS for 0x...dEaD'. The reader still worked out that the shares go to 0xdEaD.
findings.fix: e.g. 'Deposit {#.assets} into Sky Money Risk Capital vault, shares to {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: The signer's only effect is 1 USDS out, shown exactly. The shares went to 0xdEaD (signer null), which the screen states and the reader understood.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns vault shares from `onBehalf`. The count comes from previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, at the stored exchange rate net of fees.
Sends exactly `assets` USDS from the vault to `receiver`.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, spends the share allowance that onBehalf gave the signer, unless that allowance is max.
Accrues fees as shares to the fee recipients before pricing, so more shares are burned per USDS.
May pull liquidity from the liquidity adapter to cover the withdrawal. This is internal to the vault.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly <assets> USDS to <receiver>, with the owner whose shares are used as a field.

findings.title: withdraw: vault shares burned from the owner are not shown, since they come from the stored exchange rate
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1: signer out 4998274.394905667501002020 skyMoneyUsdsRiskCapital. No field shows the share amount, and the reader marked 'How many vault shares are burned' as unsure.
findings.fix: No calldata path holds it. Optionally say in the intent that vault shares are burned, e.g. 'Withdraw {#.assets} by burning your vault shares'.

findings.title: withdraw: interpolated intent omits the owner whose shares, or whose allowance to the signer, are used
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Withdraw {#.assets} to {#.receiver}'. In exit: `if (msg.sender != onBehalf) { ... allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] = _allowance - shares; }`. The Owner field is shown with visible: always.

cases.notes: The 4,999,999 USDS in to the signer is shown exactly. The 4,998,274.39 shares burned are not shown. The reader inferred that shares are reduced but did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends USDS to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), rounded down, at the stored exchange rate net of fees.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, spends the share allowance that onBehalf gave the signer, unless that allowance is max.
Accrues fees as shares to the fee recipients before pricing, which lowers the USDS paid out.
formats.shown: Redeem <shares> skyMoneyUsdsRiskCapital to <receiver>, with the owner as a field. Nothing says what token or how much comes back.

findings.title: redeem: screen never says USDS is received; only the shares going out are named
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: fields are shares, receiver and onBehalf. The interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}' has no asset out. VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. Case 2: signer in 483078.612487851807469047 USDS, not on the screen. The reader said 'the screen doesn't state the amount or token'.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDS to {#.receiver}', or label the receiver field 'USDS to'. The metadata constant underlyingTicker is already defined.

findings.title: redeem: amount of USDS paid out comes from the stored exchange rate and cannot be shown
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. The function has no minimum-assets parameter in calldata. Case 2: 483078.61 USDS received for 482953.95 shares.

findings.title: redeem: interpolated intent omits the owner whose shares, or whose allowance to the signer, are used
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. In exit: `allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] = _allowance - shares` when msg.sender != onBehalf.

cases.notes: The shares out are shown exactly and the reader got them right. The USDS in is missing from the screen: the reader guessed 'likely USDS' with no amount.
